content_descriptors.notes:
This horror action game is based on Japanese mythology and grudge spirits. This title includes the following adult-oriented elements

Expression of fear: players will experience psychological terror from the sudden appearance and pursuit of enemies as they navigate through a dark maze.
Violence (mild): If you are caught by enemies, the game is over, and there are death scenes using silhouettes and effects, but no gore or bloodshed.
Occult elements: Mystical and religious motifs such as the destruction of torii gates and the existence of grudge spirits appear.
This work does not contain extreme violent expressions or sexual contents, but please note that those who are uncomfortable with strong scare scenes are advised to use caution.
